verdict.rationale: Elicit lets researchers bring their own corpus in through Zotero import, which the docs say brings paper collections in for extraction and analysis. It also accepts RIS/BIB imports and Library Collections that can launch reviews and extractions, and Chat can compare, summarize and cluster papers. However, the RIS/BIB path covers only titles and abstracts, and nothing documents uploading arbitrary PDFs or the Research Agent working over a user-supplied corpus. Missing for 10: explicit direct PDF upload, evidence the Research Agent (not just extraction/chat) operates over an uploaded corpus, independent hands-on corroboration.
